title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Action Kamen vs. Haigure Maou
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Action Mask vs. Leotard Devil

Media.description:
By finding a rare Action Kamen card, Shinnosuke Nohara and his family end up being chosen to go to a parallel world and help foil an alien invasion that is occurring over there.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Buriburi Oukoku no Hihou
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: The Hidden Treasure of the Buri Buri Kingdom

node.description: A band of criminals want to get the treasure of the famous Treasure Island, but the key of the treasure chamber is guarded by a little kid. Then, they come to Japan and kidnap Shinosuke Nohara by mistake, who looks exactly like the little kid who has the key.

Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.

Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home.

During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Arashi wo Yobu Mouretsu! Otona Teikoku no Gyakushuu
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! The Adult Empire Strikes Back

mediaRecommendation.description:
As the 21st century approaches, a new 20th-century museum has opened in town, for the adults to relive their childhood. However, the owners of the museum seem to have other plans for it. The adults start to behave strangely, and one morning, they abandon their children for the 20th-century museum. Shinnosuke, along with his friends, must now rescue his parents and stop the world from returning to the 20th century before they get captured.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Dengeki! Buta no Hizume Daisakusen
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Blitzkrieg! Pig's Hoof's Secret Mission

mediaRecommendation.description:
A full-scale action film with tastes of the "'007" series and Jackie Chan's movies. The members of the secret organization for world peace 'SML', code-named 'Oiroke' (sexual attractiveness) and 'Kinniku' (muscle), who join hands with the Nohara family and Kasukabe Defense Forces (Shinnosuke Nohara and his mates: Kazama-kun, Nene-chan, Masao-kun and Bo-chan), and fight against the evil organization 'Buta no Hizume' (Pig's Hoof), who tries to conquer the world by using a computer virus.

(Souce: Bilibili TV)

title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Great Adventure In Henderland

mediaRecommendation.description:
A modern horror style fantasy depicting a laughable adventure in Gunma Hender Land, the largest theme park in the north areas around Tokyo. Nohara family fight with Toppema Muppet (a talking doll from Magic World) against two gay 'witch' men Makao and Joma, who came from Another World and try to invade the Real World.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Pursuit of the Balls of Darkness

mediaRecommendation.description: Shinnosuke found a black marble near a sleeping travestite and Himawari swallows it. That marble is necessary for summoning an evil demon, so the Noharas are chased by some ninja clans.

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Bakuhatsu! Onsen Wakuwaku Daikessen
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Explosion! The Hot Spring's Feel Good Final Battle

mediaRecommendation.description:
The Nohara family and "Onsen G-Men", the secret government agency maintaining all the hot springs in Japan, fight against "Yuzame", a bath-hating terrorist organization plotting to wipe out all the hot springs in Japan.

(Source Bilibili TV)

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Arashi wo Yobu Jungle
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Jungle That Invites Storm

mediaRecommendation.description:
The Nohara family is on a cruise heading towards a tropical island when suddenly the ship is invaded by a large group of monkeys. The simians capture all adults and take them to a nearby isle while leaving all children behind. It is up to Shin-chan and his friends to find and save the grown-ups.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Arashi wo Yobu Appare! Sengoku Daikassen

mediaRecommendation.description: Shin-chan and his family travel to Samurai's Era by accident and try to save the Princess' city by helping in the war.

title.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Arashi wo Yobu Eikou no Yakiniku Road
title.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! Yakiniku Road of Honor

mediaRecommendation.description:
A slapstick comedy going back to the basic, "laughable" style of the TV series. One day, the Nohara family was looking forward to having an ultra-rich yakiniku dinner, but they were put on the Wanted List on suspicion of heinous crimes because of a scheme of a mysterious organization named Sweet Boys. The Nohara family must run from Sweet Boys' pursuit but to eat yakiniku for dinner they need to stop escaping and decide to meet the boss of Sweet Boys, who is based in Atami (a hot spring/resort city in Shizuoka Prefecture).

(Source: Bilibili TV)
